description: This file defines the DebugXaResources class, which models the <debug-xa-resources> XML element in the entity configuration. It provides a way to read and interpret the 'value' attribute within the element, indicating whether XA resources debugging is enabled or disabled.

classes.name: DebugXaResources
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing the <debug-xa-resources> configuration element, encapsulating its boolean 'value' attribute.

methods.name: DebugXaResources(Element)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by reading and validating the 'value' attribute from the provided XML Element.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the boolean value indicating whether XA resources debugging is enabled.
